        t = t.transpose(2, 3)
    if k % 2 == 1:
        t = t.flip(3)
    if (k // 2) % 2 == 1:
        t = t.flip(2)

def pool3(p, dy, dx, pad):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return torch.cat([p, p, p], dim=1)
    q = F.pad(p, pad)
    mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)

        x = F.relu(self.n1(self.c1(s)))
        x = F.relu(x + self.n2(self.c2(x)))
